name: Flood Inundation Evaluation Framework
description: A framework for evaluating flood inundation prediction models across extensive benchmark databases.
evaluation_method: IoU / F1 for inundation extent and RMSE/NSE for water depth/time-series predictions
reputation: An applied framework of interest to hydrology and flood-modelling researchers but not yet a broadly standardized community benchmark.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; performance is sensitive to input data quality, scale, and hydrodynamic model choices; multiple heterogeneous metrics across datasets complicate direct comparisons.
